title: The Rogue Planet Floating Alone in Deep Space

vo.text: A lonely world floats through total darkness, burning with radioactive power.
vo.imagePrompt: Wide establishing shot of a pitch-black cosmic void, a dark rogue planet looming with eerie purple aurora crown, cold blue lighting, floating through deep space.

vo.text: Meet SIMP J0136, a massive gas giant twenty light-years from Earth.
vo.imagePrompt: Medium shot of a massive gas giant glowing with faint crimson warmth, orbiting no star, surrounded by distant dim background stars.

vo.text: It has no parent sun, meaning it drifted alone into eternal night.
vo.imagePrompt: Wide shot looking out from near the planet into an endless, empty galactic void, tiny distant galaxies scattered in darkness.

vo.text: Without solar wind, auroras should be physically impossible here. Guess how it forms them.
vo.imagePrompt: Extreme close-up of turbulent cloud belts on a giant planet, static electrical arcs crackling across dark purple atmospheres.

vo.text: Its magnetic field is two hundred times stronger than giant Jupiter's.
vo.imagePrompt: Low angle looking up, glowing invisible magnetic field lines tearing through space around the massive planet like brilliant glowing blue filaments.

vo.text: That hyper-magnetism ignites auroras ten thousand times brighter than Earth's light shows.
vo.imagePrompt: Wide cinematic shot, massive blinding violet and neon green light curtains exploding across the planet pole in deep space.

vo.text: An unseen moon might be spraying volcanic plasma directly into its atmosphere.
vo.imagePrompt: Low angle, a tiny icy volcanic moon plunging past the giant planet, blasting a vibrant trail of glowing plasma into the upper cloud layer.

vo.text: Creating a glowing light show in the coldest, dark corner of space.
vo.imagePrompt: High angle shot looking down at the entire planet glowing silently, crowned in luminous ultraviolet fire, tiny against the cosmos.

vo.text: And somewhere out there in the dark...
vo.imagePrompt: Wide establishing shot of a pitch-black cosmic void, a dark rogue planet looming with eerie purple aurora crown, cold blue lighting, floating through deep space.
